alt: 創作者在燈下反覆修改繪本畫面，桌邊散落草稿、短鉛筆與小模型，疲倦卻依然專注。
scene_prompt: An adult picture-book creator works intensely at a wooden studio desk, carefully refining an original illustrated page covered only in wordless drawings. Many discarded visual sketches, worn pencils and successive tiny paper models surround the creator. Weary eyes, ink-stained fingers and a focused thoughtful expression show deep sustained care and repeated revisions; a warm small lamp glows. No vomiting, blood, heart imagery or bodily injury, no written marks.
